svg.title: Lagrange multipliers: objective contour meets the feasible set
svg.desc: A teal point moves along the blue constraint circle while amber objective contours contract. At the constrained minimizer the objective gradient is antiparallel to the outward constraint normal. Illustrative geometry, not model data. Gradient arrows are separately normalized to show direction, not magnitude.

g.text: Illustrative constrained minimum · not a trained model
